blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
An invoice is the document that proves a sale happened. It shows what was sold, to whom, on what date, for what price, and how much tax was added. Without a correct invoice, the tax office will not accept the sale. It will not accept it as a deductible purchase either.

Every company has to keep its invoices for several years, usually five or six. The tax office can ask to see them. Missing one invoice is bad. Missing a whole year is a serious problem.

Tax documentation is quiet, repetitive work. But it is the evidence everything else stands on. If you lose it, the numbers on the tax return become very hard to defend.

items.q: What does an invoice prove?
items.why: "An invoice is the document that proves a sale happened."

items.q: How long does a company usually have to keep its invoices?
items.why: "keep its invoices for several years, usually five or six."

items.q: What can happen if the invoice is not correct?
options: The tax office will not accept the sale
items.why: "Without a correct invoice, the tax office will not accept the sale."

items.q: The text suggests that documentation work is…
items.why: Inferência: é "quiet, repetitive work", mas "the evidence everything else stands on" — pouco chamativo, mas essencial.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "You can throw invoices away after a week."
items.why: Inferência: o texto pede guardar por 5 ou 6 anos; jogar fora em uma semana é o oposto.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily ensinando o novo colega a arquivar as faturas. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, welcome to your first day with the invoices. This is the box for this quarter. Every invoice from these three months goes in here.

The rule is simple. We keep them by date, oldest first. Each one gets a number in the top corner. Then I write the same number on our list. So the paper and the list always match.

Why do we do this? Because three years from now, someone can ask for one invoice. Maybe the tax office. Maybe our boss. And we must find it fast — in under a minute. If the box is a mess, we can lose an hour looking for one page.

Do not throw anything away. Even a small receipt can be a deductible purchase. If you are not sure, keep it and ask me.

When the box is full, we close it, write the quarter on the front, and put it on the shelf. Five or six years, we keep it. That is the job. It is quiet work, but the whole tax return stands on these papers.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does Emily keep the invoices in the box?
items.why: "We keep them by date, oldest first."

items.q: Why does she write a number on the invoice and on the list?
options: So the paper and the list always match
To make the box look nice
items.why: "So the paper and the list always match."

items.q: How fast must they be able to find one invoice?
items.why: "we must find it fast — in under a minute."

items.q: Why does Emily say "do not throw anything away"?
options: Because even a small receipt can be a deductible purchase
Because the boss counts the papers
Because the box must be full
items.why: Inferência: um pequeno recibo pode virar compra dedutível, então nada se joga fora.

items.q: How would you describe Emily's advice to the new person?
items.why: Inferência: ela dá regras simples e diz "if you are not sure, keep it and ask me" — é cuidadosa e clara.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please send me the invoice for last month." An invoice is…
options: a bill that shows what was sold and the price
items.why: Invoice = fatura: mostra o que foi vendido e o valor.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We must ___ every invoice for five or six years."
items.why: To keep = guardar; guardamos as faturas por anos.

items.q: "One invoice is missing from the box." Missing means…
items.why: Missing = faltando, não está no lugar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The invoice is the ___ that proves the sale."
items.why: Evidence = evidência/prova; a fatura prova a venda.

items.q: "If the numbers are wrong, they are hard to defend." To defend here means…
items.why: To defend = defender; mostrar que os números estão certos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com faturas. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the invoice." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Can you fill in the date on this invoice?" To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher a informação que falta.

items.q: "Please hold on to every receipt." To hold on to means to…
items.why: Hold on to = segurar, guardar.

items.q: "We need to sort out the box before the tax office comes." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = organizar, pôr em ordem.

items.q: "I can't find that invoice — it is missing." What is the problem?
items.why: Missing = faltando; a fatura não está no lugar.
